Name: Liberty
Description: Liberty was a preteen science prodigy who got attention after winning a prestigious award for her light-bending flight harness. At some point, she was taken in by Hydra, to help them appeal to a younger demographic and represent a Hydra new world order. As a member of The Assembly, she would have a run in with Spider-Woman, who helped reveal the truth to her and her teammates.
